"""Build evidence mappings from durable case reviews without inventing automation."""
import argparse,fcntl,hashlib,json,re,sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/Users/lushevol/code/github/ratan-release-impact/workbench')
TASK=ROOT/'tasks/ui-test-coverage-20261022'
OUT=TASK/'evidence/refinement'
CATALOG=TASK/'test-cases.md'
LOCK=Path('/tmp/refine-ui-catalog-20261022.lock')
IDENTITIES={
 'accessible_name':'accessible_name','label':'visible_label','visible_label':'visible_label',
 'visible_text':'visible_label','visible_title':'visible_label','visible_heading':'visible_label',
 'column_heading':'visible_label','fixture_title':'visible_label','tooltip':'visible_label',
 'alt':'accessible_name','test_id':'test_id','stable_identifier':'stable_identifier',
 'source_pattern':'stable_identifier','source_property':'stable_identifier','placeholder':'stable_identifier'
}
def build():
 with LOCK.open('a+') as lock:
  fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
  payload=CATALOG.read_bytes();text=payload.decode();lines=text.splitlines();catalog_hash=hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
  latest={}
  for line in (OUT/'case-reviews.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
   if line.strip():
    record=json.loads(line);latest[record['case_id']]=record
  source_manifest=json.loads((TASK/'evidence/source-manifest.json').read_text())
  sources={r['evidence_id']:r for r in source_manifest['sources']}
  evidence={};unknown_refs=set();hash_conflicts=[];canonical_mismatches=[];pending=[];scenarios={};basis_counts=Counter();narrow_count=0
  def source_ref(sid,role,bounds=None):
   nonlocal narrow_count
   if sid not in sources:
    unknown_refs.add(sid)
    return sid+':'+role
   source=sources[sid];path=ROOT/source['path'];raw=path.read_bytes();count=len(raw.decode().splitlines())
   start,end=bounds if bounds else (1,count)
   if not 1<=start<=end<=count:raise ValueError(f'{sid}: source range {start}:{end} exceeds {count} lines')
   key=sid+':'+role+(f':L{start}-L{end}' if bounds else '')
   authority='established' if source['path'].startswith('repos/') else 'draft'
   item={'path':source['path'],'sha256':source['sha256'],'start_line':start,'end_line':end,'kind':role,'authority':authority}
   if source.get('revision'):item['revision']=source['revision']
   evidence[key]=item
   if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=source['sha256']:hash_conflicts.append(sid)
   if bounds:narrow_count+=1
   return key
  for sid in sources:
   source_ref(sid,'behavior');source_ref(sid,'ui')
  headings=list(re.finditer(r'^#### ([A-Z][A-Z0-9-]+)\s*$',text,re.M))
  for i,match in enumerate(headings):
   cid=match[1];end=headings[i+1].start() if i+1<len(headings) else len(text)
   block=text[match.start():end]
   # Shared group and execution sections do not belong to the canonical case bytes.
   boundary=re.search(r'^### Group:|^## Execution binding',block,re.M)
   if boundary:block=block[:boundary.start()]
   if cid not in latest:pending.append(cid);continue
   record=latest[cid]
   if hashlib.sha256(block.encode()).hexdigest()!=record['canonical_case_sha256']:canonical_mismatches.append(cid)
   block_start=text.count('\n',0,match.start())+1
   steps=[];in_gherkin=False
   for offset,line in enumerate(block.splitlines()):
    if line=='```gherkin':in_gherkin=True;continue
    if in_gherkin and line=='```':in_gherkin=False
    if in_gherkin and re.match(r'^\s*(Given|When|Then|And|But|\*)\s+',line):steps.append((block_start+offset,line.strip()))
   if len(steps)!=len(record['steps']):raise ValueError(f'{cid}: {len(steps)} canonical steps != {len(record["steps"])} review mappings')
   basis=re.search(r'Basis: `([^`]+)`',block)[1];basis_counts[basis]+=1
   authority={'IMPLEMENTATION':'established','DOCUMENTED':'draft','PROPOSED':'unknown'}[basis]
   intentline=next(block_start+j for j,line in enumerate(block.splitlines()) if line.startswith('Business intent:'))
   requirement=cid+':intent'
   evidence[requirement]={'path':str(CATALOG.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':catalog_hash,'start_line':intentline,'end_line':intentline,'kind':'behavior','authority':authority}
   components={}
   for key,c in record['components'].items():
    sl=c.get('source_lines',{})
    components[key]={'type':c['type'],'identity':c['identity'],'identity_kind':IDENTITIES[c['identity_kind']],'scope':c['scope'],
                     'evidence':[source_ref(sid,'ui',sl.get(sid)) for sid in c['evidence']]}
   mappings={};first_assertion=None
   for (lineno,clause),meta in zip(steps,record['steps']):
    target_refs=meta.get('components',[])
    # Source-role aliases distinguish support responsibility without changing source authority.
    role='ui' if target_refs or meta.get('observation')=='ui' else 'behavior'
    supporting=[source_ref(sid,role,meta.get('source_lines',{}).get(sid)) for sid in meta['evidence']]
    if meta['kind']=='assertion':
     first_assertion=first_assertion or lineno
     if basis!='IMPLEMENTATION':supporting.append(requirement)
    value={'kind':meta['kind'],'evidence':list(dict.fromkeys(supporting))}
    if target_refs:value['components']=target_refs
    if meta.get('observation'):value['observation']=meta['observation']
    mappings[str(lineno)]=value
   authority_note={'IMPLEMENTATION':'Established implementation characterization only. No approved business requirement is asserted.',
                   'DOCUMENTED':'Documented draft expectation. Business review and applicability remain unresolved.',
                   'PROPOSED':'Proposed expectation with unknown business authority. Source implementation does not approve this outcome.'}[basis]
   notes=authority_note+' '+record.get('notes','')+' '+' '.join(record.get('gaps',[]))+' Owner: unknown. Execution: NOT_RUN. No automation bindings are claimed.'
   scenarios[cid]={'file':str(CATALOG.relative_to(ROOT)),'sha256':catalog_hash,
                   'behavior':{'intent':record['business_intent'],'requirement':requirement,'criterion':str(CATALOG.relative_to(ROOT))+f'#L{first_assertion or intentline}'},
                   'components':components,'steps':mappings,
                   'review':{'state':'UNVERIFIED','reviewer':None,'reviewed_at':None,'notes':notes.strip()}}
  manifest={'version':1,'evidence':evidence,'scenarios':scenarios}
  path=OUT/'gherkin-manifest.json';path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
  diagnostics={'catalog_sha256':catalog_hash,'scenarios':len(scenarios),'pending_count':len(pending),'pending_ids':pending,
               'basis_counts':dict(basis_counts),'source_evidence_aliases':len(evidence),'narrow_component_refs':narrow_count,
               'unknown_source_refs':sorted(unknown_refs),'source_hash_conflicts':sorted(set(hash_conflicts)),
               'canonical_checkpoint_mismatches':canonical_mismatches,'semantic_review':'UNVERIFIED','automation_ready':False,
               'execution_status':'NOT_RUN','manifest_path':str(path.relative_to(ROOT))}
  (OUT/'manifest-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(diagnostics,indent=2)+'\n')
  return manifest,diagnostics
if __name__=='__main__':
 manifest,diagnostics=build();print(json.dumps(diagnostics,indent=2))
